welcome.title: Welcome to Tensho!
welcome.content: Tensho is a roguelike game built around Japanese Riichi Mahjong. Your goal is to build scoring hands and reach the target score each round.

tiles.title: Mahjong Tiles
tiles.content1: There are three main suits: Characters (萬), Circles (筒), and Bamboo (索), each numbered 1-9.

honors.title: Honor Tiles
honors.content: Honor tiles include Winds (East, South, West, North) and Dragons (White, Green, Red). These tiles cannot form sequences, only triplets.

hands.title: Building Hands
hands.content1: A winning hand consists of 4 groups (melds) plus 1 pair.
hands.content2: Groups can be sequences (1-2-3) or triplets (3-3-3).

yaku.title: Yaku - Scoring Patterns
yaku.content1: Yaku are special patterns that multiply your score. Each yaku has a tier from 1-4.
yaku.content2: Examples: All Simples (no terminals/honors), All Triplets, Full Flush (single suit).

decrees.title: Decrees - Rule Modifiers
decrees.content1: Decrees are special cards that modify the rules and boost your score.
decrees.content2: Collect powerful decrees from the Tea House (shop) between rounds.

scoring.title: Scoring Formula
scoring.content: Reach the target score each round to advance. Higher acts require higher scores!

ready.title: You're Ready!
ready.content2: Press PLAY to begin your first run.
